overview_description.description: Cents helps laundromats and garment care businesses manage operations, payments, and customer interactions. Its system includes point-of-sale tools, digital payment processing, and business management features that support order tracking and reporting. The platform also offers customer-facing applications for scheduling services, placing orders, and making payments. Cents integrates hardware and software components to support both self-service and full-service laundry operations. It enables business owners to monitor performance, manage workflows, and handle transactions within a single system.

about_short_description.short_description: Cents is a laundromat software platform that helps laundromat owners streamline their operations and enhance customer experience.

product.name: Cents Business Management
product.description: Cloud-based software for managing laundromat operations, including orders, employees, machines, pricing, revenue, customer data, reporting, and multiple locations.

product.name: Cents Point of Sale
product.description: Industry-specific point-of-sale software for accepting payments, managing wash-and-fold and dry-cleaning orders, tracking services, and maintaining customer records.

product.name: Cents Connect
product.description: A machine payment and monitoring system that connects commercial laundry equipment to digital payments, remote controls, diagnostics, pricing, and usage reporting.

product.name: Cents Dispatch
product.description: Pickup-and-delivery management software for scheduling orders, defining service areas, optimizing routes, managing drivers, and providing customer tracking.

product.name: Cents Accelerate
product.description: Marketing and reputation-management software for laundromats, with email and SMS campaigns, customer segmentation, loyalty programs, promotions, websites, and review management.

product.name: Cents Assist
product.description: An AI receptionist service for laundromats and dry cleaners that answers calls and texts, handles FAQs and orders, and escalates requests to human staff.
